rationale: Reviewed PR #824 (EPMCDME-15582_fix-session-summary-turns vs main, 28 files in the raw branch-vs-base diff). The raw diff is 93% non-functional bookkeeping: prior SDLC/code-review run artifacts (docs/superpowers/reviews/**, docs/superpowers/tasks/**) that got committed to the branch across its history; these carry no runtime behavior and were excluded from lens review after confirming via `git diff --stat` that only 5 files are functional. The real functional diff (389 lines) touches: docs/ARCHITECTURE-OTLP-PLUGIN.md (one table-row doc update), src/agents/plugins/claude-code-otlp/transcript/session-signals.ts + 2 test files, and src/agents/plugins/claude/session/claude-named-invocations.ts + its test file. Blind and edge-case lenses ran in parallel against the isolated functional diff (acceptance lens skipped — no story/spec artifact exists under docs/superpowers/tasks or docs/stories for EPMCDME-15582; this is a no-spec round). Both lenses surfaced edge-case concerns around the new isMarkedLocalCommand/isCompactCommand/isFollowedByCompactBoundary functions in session-signals.ts (interleaved commands before a compact_boundary flushes, Stop firing before the boundary line lands, regex whitespace tolerance, an assistant line being misread as a caveat). All were verified against the actual current source (src/agents/plugins/claude-code-otlp/transcript/session-signals.ts:163-234) and found unreachable in practice: Claude Code's CLI processes `/compact` synchronously — the `compact_boundary` system line is written as part of handling that command, strictly before the CLI accepts the next user input — so none of the hypothesized interleavings (a second local command or a new Stop event landing before the boundary flushes) can actually occur in a real transcript. The isMarkedLocalCommand prefix check (`startsWith('<local-command-caveat>')`) also makes the 'assistant line misread as caveat' scenario require the assistant to literally emit that exact tag, which is not a realistic transcript shape. The claude-named-invocations.ts refactor (scanCommands -> matchCommandNames + explicit bump call sites) is behavior-preserving on direct reading — ordering within and across content blocks is unchanged from the original single-pass scan. No security, injection, or unsafe I/O concerns (pure string/array/regex logic, no console.* debug output). All 20 commits on the branch follow Conventional Commits with the EPMCDME-15582 ticket reference. New exported functions carry explicit types; no `any` introduced. Confidence is forced to 'low' per orchestrator rules because this is a no-spec round (no acceptance criteria could be audited) — not because of any identified defect.

standards_review.notes: All 20 commits on the branch follow Conventional Commits (fix(agents): EPMCDME-15582 ..., docs: ..., chore: ..., revert(agents): ...) per git log; ticket id present in every functional commit subject.
New/changed functions (isMarkedLocalCommand, isCompactCommand, isFollowedByCompactBoundary, matchCommandNames) use explicit types, no `any`; pure/no-I/O convention of session-signals.ts preserved.
No secrets, injection, or unsafe file/process handling; pure in-memory string/regex/array logic only; no console.* debug output introduced.
